rules.name: No Import Table Patches
rules.description: Patches to the import address table (IAT), PLT, or export address table (EAT) are blocked. Modifying imports can mask malicious DLL hijacking or hide API call redirection that bypasses security controls.
rules.resolution: Remove this patch. Use semantic renaming instead.

rules.name: No PII in Comments
rules.description: Comments must not contain personally identifiable information, internal IP addresses, credentials, or secret keys. Sensitive values are automatically redacted before annotation is committed.
rules.resolution: Review redacted content and remove sensitive data before committing.

rules.name: No Misleading Renames
rules.description: Function/variable renames must not misrepresent the actual functionality. Names that suggest security properties ('safe', 'secure', 'harmless') when dangerous APIs are used are flagged.
rules.resolution: Remove security-suggesting keywords from name, or verify operation is genuinely safe.

rules.name: No Unsafe Stack Frame Changes
rules.description: Changes to stack frame layout (frame size, local variable types, calling convention) require explicit validation. Incorrect stack frame types can cause decompiler crashes or silent misanalysis.
rules.resolution: Validate frame layout with funcs(action='info', include_stack=True) before committing.

rules.name: No Unknown Code Execution
rules.description: Dynamic execution of code with unknown origin is blocked. This prevents accidental detonation of malicious payloads during sandbox analysis or deobfuscation attempts.
rules.resolution: Sandbox the code first, verify origin, or use static analysis instead.

rules.name: No Rename of Library/FLIRT Functions
rules.description: Renaming functions identified by FLIRT signatures or import tables can break cross-reference analysis and obscure known library behavior.
rules.resolution: Set override flag or verify the rename is intentional.
